causal.assumptions_right: Crude still prices Canada as the surplus exporter and Japan as the importer, so the live CADJPY mark continues to transmit the intended terms-of-trade gap.
causal.assumptions_wrong_or_underweighted: Competition rank can fall from residual path in already-closed AUDCAD expressions and from peers harvesting dollar-directional beta even while the Canada-Japan oil differential is paying.
causal.causal_divergence: The rank move and 67780 drawdown score closed Australia-Canada residuals and peer-relative P&L, not a reversal in the oil-supported Canada-versus-Japan cross that is still above entry.
causal.future_implication: A competition rank drop is not a new Australia-versus-Canada policy, growth, or inflation gap and must not reopen faded AUDCAD or replace CADJPY with a dollar pair.
causal.observed_reality: Rank slipped from 8 to 12 with about 67780 of net and drawdown even as CADJPY prints 111.59 above 110.90 and AONIA 4.60 versus CORRA 2.27 shows no new Australia-Canada policy, growth, or inflation shock.
causal.original_belief: A CADJPY long that isolates Canada's oil surplus against Japan's energy-import bill would keep overnight relative-value performance competitive without needing a fresh Australia-Canada trade.
causal.same_information_counterfactual: With the same oil tape, the same AONIA-CORRA wedge, and the same 111.59 CADJPY print, cutting the working long or reversing the closed AUDCAD fade would have added expression noise rather than repaired rank.

items.no_new_lesson: The 8-to-12 rank move and 67780 drawdown are the leaderboard echo of already-closed Australia-Canada fades plus peer-relative scoring; they sit inside ordinary competition variance around an intact oil-supported CADJPY differential, so the original process remains sound: hold the working Canada-Japan cross and leave the closed fade shut on a known cash gap.
items.what_happened_vs_expected: The oil-supported CADJPY long was expected to keep overnight relative-value standing stable; instead competition rank moved from 8 to 12 with about 67780 of net and drawdown while the live long is still above the 110.90 entry and the Australia-Canada cash wedge is unchanged.

causal.assumptions_right: The non-dollar cross was the right place to express rich Australia against cheap New Zealand, and the cross did break its 20-session range lower while remaining historically rich.
causal.assumptions_wrong_or_underweighted: The path was treated as if a multi-week fade should be monotonic, underweighting ordinary back-and-forth inside a still-rich cross and the fact that a one-session standing slip does not mean the differential failed.
causal.causal_divergence: Standing moved while the instrument kept the short's direction, so the scoreboard diverged from the cross that was actually being tested.
causal.future_implication: Keep a reduced Australian dollar-kiwi short while the five-year extreme remains, and do not re-initiate the original full size at the 20-session low or reopen the closed Australia-Canada fade.
causal.observed_reality: Standing fell while the short was still onside, and the same short later pushed to a fresh open-profit high with spot at 1.2266, still a five-year z-score of 2.34.
causal.original_belief: A short Australian dollar-kiwi sized for a multi-week fade of extreme Australia-versus-New Zealand richness would pay lower without a leaderboard air pocket once the cross had already started to decline.
causal.same_information_counterfactual: With the same cross still rich and the horizon only partly elapsed, the book should have stayed short and should not have flipped into Australian dollar-Canada or covered on the standing slip.

items.no_new_lesson: The standing slip was path around an intact Australia-versus-New Zealand short that later extended, so the original process remains sound: the cross was the right expression, the closed Australia-Canada fade stays shut, and a multi-week richness book is not abandoned because standing dipped for a session.
items.what_happened_vs_expected: The Australian dollar-kiwi short was expected to keep paying as a multi-week fade of five-year richness without a one-session air pocket in standing.
